metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "Insurance claims platform" {
    model {
        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Reports claims and tracks their progress"

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "Owned and operated by our insurance company" {
            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app"
            intake = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims"
            triage = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims"
            assessment = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts"
            payout = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements"
            fraudScreening = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims"
            document = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports"
            notification = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders"
            assignment = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims"
            policyVerification = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy"
            reinsuranceAllocation = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts"
            claimsDb = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records"
            policyDb = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence"
        }

        claimsBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "Operated by a different organization"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "Operated by a different organization"

        policyholder -> webPortal "reports claims and tracks progress"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks progress via the mobile app"

        webPortal -> intake "submits new claims"
        webPortal -> assessment "requests settlement amounts"
        webPortal -> payout "requests settlements"
        webPortal -> document "uploads claim photos and reports"
        webPortal -> notification "requests status notifications"

        mobileAppBackend -> intake "submits new claims"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessment "requests settlement amounts"
        mobileAppBackend -> payout "requests settlements"
        mobileAppBackend -> document "uploads claim photos and reports"
        mobileAppBackend -> notification "requests status notifications"

        intake -> triage "hands accepted claims to"
        triage -> assessment "routes claims to"
        assessment -> payout "requests settlements from"

        fraudScreening -> claimsBureau "consults"
        payout -> clearingHouse "executes settlements through"

        assignment -> adjusterWorkbench "routes the claim to"
        document -> documentStore "reads from"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDb "reads and writes"
        batchScheduler -> policyDb "reads and writes"
        notification -> policyholder "emails and messages"
    }
}
